correctness.rationale: The source identity is \(\mathcal R_0=C\,\mathbb E[\Theta(\Theta-1)]\). The lower envelope follows from the integer inequality \((n-k)(n-k-1)\ge0\), with equality exactly on adjacent support points. The upper envelope follows from \(n(K-n)\ge0\), with equality exactly at the endpoints. The stated two-point laws satisfy the mean constraint and attain the bounds; convex mixtures attain the full interval. The unbounded no-cap statement is witnessed by exact two-point laws whose factorial moment is \(m(L-1)\).

value.rationale: The source motivates its reproduction number as a tool for defining gathering-size restrictions, while independent epidemiological work emphasizes that the gathering-size distribution is often heavy-tailed and policy-relevant. The theorem gives the exact best- and worst-case invasion numbers compatible with only a reported mean and a legal cap, identifies all sharp extremizers, and shows by an explicit same-mean same-cap example that distribution shape alone can flip the epidemic threshold. The no-cap result further proves that mean gathering size by itself supplies no finite worst-case invasion bound.
